_comment: Curated fixes for khmdhs (Anti-nero) contracts whose registry stated values are keying errors. Same format and mechanism as dase_contract_corrections.json: keyed by contract ΑΔΑΜ; total_cost_with_vat / total_cost_without_vat override the registry amounts when the signed PDF documents a different figure (cite the source in 'reason'); optional 'objects' maps contract_objects seq → corrected cost_without_vat where the child row repeats the error. Applied by khmdhs.contract_corrections — standalone CLI (--db data/processed/khmdhs.sqlite --corrections this file) and by khmdhs.refresh right after the refetch/upsert phase (INSERT OR REPLACE restores registry values). Corrections land only after human PDF review (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-14).

26SYMV018642772.reason: KHMDHS records net €3,341,238.72 / gross €4,143,136.01 — exactly the figures of 25SYMV017471484 «ΔΕΞΑΜΕΝΕΣ & ΚΡΟΥΝΟΙ ΠΕΡΙΑΣΤΙΚΟΥ ΔΑΣΟΥΣ ΘΕΣΣΑΛΟΝΙΚΗΣ» (whose own PDF confirms them in words), a cross-contract keying error. 22SYMV010795606.note: ΚΗΜΔΗΣ records one contractor for this contract, ΑΦΜ 998255970. The signed contract names two: it was awarded to a κοινοπραξία of ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΙΑΚΗ ΠΡΑΣΙΝΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΙΑ Ε.Ε. and ΓΕΩΓΝΩΜΩΝ Ο.Ε., and that κοινοπραξία has no ΑΦΜ of its own — the registry used the first company's. Both companies are shown here, and the contract's value is split evenly between them, as on every jointly signed contract.
22SYMV010795606.party_reason: The contract is signed by a κοινοπραξία that states NO ΑΦΜ of its own, so the registry keyed it under member α alone (998255970, «ΚΞΙΑ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΙΑΚΗ ΠΡΑΣΙΝΟΥ ΓΕΩΓΝΩΜΩΝ ΟΕ») and credited that firm the whole €836.613,02. Found by the party-clause screen of 2026-08-20 (scripts/screen_joint_ventures.py), user decision the same day. 998255970 is the firm's own ΑΦΜ, not the venture's: ΓΕΜΗ 124272601000 registers it as «ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΙΑΚΗ ΠΡΑΣΙΝΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΙΑ ΕΕ», legal form ΕΕ. Its three other in-scope contracts (23SYMV013039380, 26SYMV018725481, 26SYMV018739467) name «η ετερόρρυθμη εταιρεία … (στο εξής ο «Ανάδοχος»)» and no venture at all, so they are correctly its own and stay untouched. ΓΕΩΓΝΩΜΩΝ Ο.Ε. (998434068, ΓΕΜΗ 35248216000, Πάτρα) holds two in-scope contracts in its own name. Both payment orders on this contract pay «ΚΞΙΑ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΙΑΚΗ ΠΡΑΣΙΝΟΥ - ΓΕΩΓΝΩΜΩΝ Ο.Ε.», i.e. the pair. Recording both parties lets the shared even-split give each €418.306,51 instead of charging one signatory the pair's whole contract; the basis does not move and the contract count stays whole. Registry list untouched in raw_json.
